Forty-eight homes on one quiet avenue

2 BHK townhouses in a gated campus off Waghodia Main Road.

Lake Tree Avenue is a gated campus of 48 two-bedroom townhouses, each with its own entrance, private terrace and parking.

A 12-metre town planning road brings you to the gate. Inside, 7.5-metre internal roads reach every door.

Two plan types: six homes in the entrance row, forty-two along the avenue.

ParkingOn plot, plus open-space parking

Specifications & campus

What is built in, before you move a thing.

Structure
As per architect and structure design.
Wall finish
Putty on internal walls. Exposed brick work on the front exterior wall as per architect design, exterior paint on other exterior walls.
Flooring
Vitrified flooring in all rooms with skirting. Anti-skid ceramic tiles in all balconies.
Kitchen
Granite platform with stainless steel sink, ceramic tiles up to lintel level.
Bathrooms
Designer wall tiles up to lintel level, good quality sanitary and plumbing fixtures, stone door frame.
Electrical
Good quality modular switches, AC point in the master bedroom, geyser point in all bathrooms.
Doors & windows
Elegant main door and internal flush doors with laminate and stone frame. Colour-anodised aluminium windows with safety grills.
Terrace
Brick bed waterproofing treatment.
Protection
Anti-termite treatment at ground level. Overhead and underground water tanks.
Across the campus
  • Impressive gate with security cabin
  • Large open-space parking
  • Underground cabling for a wire-free campus
  • Tremix concrete internal roads with paved sides
  • Roadside plantation and street lights
  • Rain water harvesting system
  • Garbage storage provision
  • Landscape garden with community hall

Waghodia Main Road

On Vadodara's eastern growth corridor, toward Halol.

The gate opens onto the main Waghodia road, so there is no approach lane to negotiate and no last-mile detour.
